samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>Radix-2 Divider</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">Valid operation request signal.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">Valid result signal, indicating that the result is ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output signal containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE" value="1'b0">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE" value="1'b1">Divide state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="dividend_reg" width_description="[7:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="8'h00" clear_on_rst="true">Stores the dividend during division.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_reg" width_description="[7:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="8'h00" clear_on_rst="true">Stores the divisor during division.</reg>
        <reg id="sign_reg" width_description="[0:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="1'b0" clear_on_rst="true">Stores the sign indication during division.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="4'd0" clear_on_rst="true">Counter for division iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt" width_description="[0:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="1'b0" clear_on_rst="true">Start counter signal.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg" width_description="[0:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="1'b0" clear_on_rst="true">Register to indicate result validity.</reg>
        <reg id="SR" width_description="[16:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="17'h00000" clear_on_rst="true">Shift register for division calculations.</reg>
        <reg id="NEG_DIVISOR" width_description="[16:0]" type="posedge_clk" init_value="17'h00000" clear_on_rst="true">Negative divisor value for subtraction.</reg>
        
        // State transition logic
        <always_comb>
            <case condition="state == IDLE">
                <if condition="opn_valid && !res_valid">
                    <then>
                        <assign next_state = DIVIDE;
                    </then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <assign next_state = IDLE;
                </else>
            </case>
            
            <case condition="state == DIVIDE">
                <if condition="cnt[3]">
                    <then>
                        <assign next_state = IDLE;
                    </then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <assign next_state = DIVIDE;
                </else>
            </case>
        </always_comb>
        
        // Counter logic
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                if(state == DIVIDE) begin
                    if(cnt[3]) begin
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 4'd1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Result validity management
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if(res_valid_reg && res_valid_consumed()) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
                end else if(opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Division calculation logic
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                dividend_reg <= 8'h00;
                divisor_reg <= 8'h00;
                sign_reg <= 1'b0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                SR <= 17'h00000;
                NEG_DIVISOR <= 17'h00000;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if(opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                            dividend_reg <= dividend;
                            divisor_reg <= divisor;
                            sign_reg <= sign;
                            start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                            SR <= {9'h000, dividend};
                            NEG_DIVISOR <= ~{9'h000, divisor} + 17'h00001;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    DIVIDE: begin
                        if(start_cnt) begin
                            if(cnt[3]) begin
                                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                                SR <= {neg_carry_out, SR[16:1]};
                            end else begin
                                SR <= {neg_carry_out, SR[16:1]};
                            end
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <task id="res_valid_consumed">
        <description>Determines if the result has been consumed.</description>
        <return_type id="bool">Boolean indicating if the result has been consumed.</return_type>
        <block>
            <assign return_value = res_valid_reg;
        </block>
    </task>
    
    <implementation>Handles the logic for the Radix-2 Divider module.</implementation>
</module>
